Yaqeenan saahibaan-e-imaan kaamyaab ho gaye
Jo apni namaazon mein gidgidaane waale hain
Aur laghw baaton se e'raaz karne waale hain
Aur zakaat ada karne waale hain
Aur apni sharmgaahon ki hifaazat karne waale hain
Ilaawa apni biwiyon aur apne haathon ki milkiyat kaneezon ke, ke un ke mu'aamle mein un par koi ilzaam aane waala nahin hai
Phir us ke ilaawa jo koi aur raasta talaash karega woh zyaadati karne waala hoga
Aur jo momineen apni amaanaton aur apne waadon ka lihaaz rakhne waale hain
Aur jo apni namaazon ki paabandi karne waale hain
Dar-haqeeqat yahi woh waarisaan-e-Jannat hain
Jo Firdaus ke waaris banenge aur us mein hamesha hamesha rehne waale hain
Aur hum ne insaan ko geeli mitti se paida kiya hai
Phir use ek mahfooz jagah par nutfa bana kar rakha hai

Phir nutfe ko alaqa banaaya hai, aur phir alaqe se muzgha paida kiya hai, aur phir muzghe se haddiyaan paida ki hain, aur phir haddiyon par gosht chadhaaya hai, phir hum ne use ek doosri makhlooq bana diya hai. To kis qadar ba-barakat hai woh Khuda jo sab se behtar khalq karne waala hai
Phir us ke baad tum sab mar jaane waale ho
Phir us ke baad tum roz-e-qiyaamat dobaara uthaaye jaaoge
Aur hum ne tumhaare oopar teh-ba-teh saat aasmaan banaaye hain, aur hum apni makhlooqaat se ghaafil nahin hain
Aur hum ne aasmaan se ek makhsoos miqdaar mein paani naazil kiya hai aur phir use zameen mein thehra diya hai, jab ke hum us ke waapas le jaane par bhi qaadir the
Phir hum ne us paani se tumhaare liye khurme aur angoor ke baaghaat paida kiye hain jin mein bahut zyaada meve paaye jaate hain, aur tum unhi mein se kuch kha bhi lete ho
Aur woh darakht paida kiya hai jo Toor-e-Seena mein paida hota hai, us se tel bhi nikalta hai aur woh khaane waalon ke liye saalan bhi hai

Aur beshak tumhaare liye in jaanwaron mein bhi ibrat ka saamaan hai, ke hum un ke shikam mein se tumhaare seeraab karne ka intezaam karte hain, aur tumhaare liye un mein bahut se fawaaid hain, aur un mein se bhi tum khaate ho
Aur tumhein in jaanwaron par aur kashtiyon par sawaar kiya jaata hai
Aur hum ne Nooh ko un ki qaum ki taraf bheja to unhon ne kaha ke qaum waalo! Khuda ki ibaadat karo ke tumhaare liye us ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, to tum us se kyon nahin darte ho

Un ki qaum ke kaafir ru'asa ne kaha ke yeh Nooh tumhaare hi jaise insaan hain jo tum par bartari haasil karna chaahte hain, haalaanke Khuda chaahta to malaaika ko bhi naazil kar sakta tha. Yeh to hum ne apne baap daada se kabhi nahin suna hai
Dar-haqeeqat yeh ek aise insaan hain jinhein junoon ho gaya hai, lihaaza chand din un ke haalaat ka intezaar karo
To Nooh ne dua ki ke Parwardigar! Un ki takzeeb ke muqaable mein meri madad farma

To hum ne un ki taraf wahi ki ke hamaari nigaah ke saamne aur hamaare ishaare ke mutaabiq kashti banaao, aur phir jab hamaara hukm aa jaaye aur tanoor ubalne lage to usi kashti mein har jode mein se do do ko le lena aur apne ahl ko le kar rawaana ho jaana, ilaawa un afraad ke jin ke baare mein pehle hi hamaara faisla ho chuka hai, aur mujh se zulm karne waalon ke baare mein guftugu na karna ke yeh sab gharq kar diye jaane waale hain
Us ke baad jab tum apne saathiyon samet kashti par itmenaan se baith jaana to kehna ke shukr hai us Parwardigar ka jis ne hum ko zaalim qaum se najaat dila di hai
Aur yeh kehna ke Parwardigar! Hum ko ba-barakat manzil par utaarna ke tu behtareen utaarne waala hai
Is amr mein hamaari bahut si nishaaniyaan hain, aur hum to bas imtehaan lene waale hain
Us ke baad phir hum ne doosri qaumon ko paida kiya
Aur un mein bhi apne rasool ko bheja ke tum sab Allah ki ibaadat karo ke us ke ilaawa tumhaara koi khuda nahin hai, to kya tum parhezgaar na banoge

To un ki qaum ke un ru'asa ne jinhon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya tha aur aakhirat ki mulaaqaat ka inkaar kar diya tha, aur hum ne inhein zindagaani-e-duniya mein aish o ishrat ka saamaan de diya tha, woh kehne lage ke yeh to tumhaara hi jaisa ek bashar hai, jo tum khaate ho wahi khaata hai aur jo tum peete ho wahi peeta bhi hai
Aur agar tum ne apne hi jaise bashar ki itaa'at kar li to yaqeenan khasaara uthaane waale ho jaaoge
Kya yeh tum se is baat ka waada karta hai ke jab tum mar jaaoge aur khaak aur haddi ho jaaoge to phir dobaara nikaale jaaoge
Haif sad haif! Tum se kis baat ka waada kiya ja raha hai
Yeh to sirf ek zindagaani-e-duniya hai jahaan hum marenge aur jiyenge, aur dobaara zinda hone waale nahin hain
Yeh ek aisa aadmi hai jo Khuda par bohtaan baandhta hai, aur hum is par imaan laane waale nahin hain
Us rasool ne kaha ke Parwardigar! Tu hamaari madad farma ke yeh sab hamaari takzeeb kar rahe hain
Irshaad hua ke anqareeb yeh log pashemaan ho jaayenge
Nateeja yeh hua ke inhein ek barhaq chinghaad ne apni giraft mein le liya aur hum ne inhein kooda karkat bana diya, ke zaalim qaum ke liye halaakat aur barbaadi hi hai
Phir us ke baad hum ne doosri qaumon ko eejaad kiya
Koi ummat na apne muqarrara waqt se aage badh sakti hai aur na peechhe hat sakti hai

Us ke baad hum ne musalsal rasool bheje, aur jab kisi ummat ke paas koi rasool aaya to us ne rasool ki takzeeb ki, aur hum ne bhi sab ko azaab ki manzil mein ek ke peechhe ek laga diya aur sab ko ek afsaana bana kar chhod diya, ke halaakat us qaum ke liye hai jo imaan nahin laati hai
Phir hum ne Moosa aur un ke bhai Haaroon ko apni nishaaniyon aur waazeh daleel ke saath bheja
Fir'aun aur us ke zu'ama-e-mamlakat ki taraf, to un logon ne bhi istikbaar kiya, aur woh to the hi oonche qism ke log
To un logon ne keh diya ke kya hum apne hi jaise do aadmiyon par imaan le aayein jab ke un ki qaum khud hamaari parastish kar rahi hai
Yeh keh kar dono ko jhutla diya aur is tarah halaak hone waalon mein shaamil ho gaye
Aur hum ne Moosa ko kitaab di ke shaayad is tarah log hidaayat haasil kar lein
Aur hum ne Ibn-e-Maryam aur un ki waalida ko bhi apni nishaani qaraar diya, aur inhein ek bulandi par jahaan thehrne ki jagah bhi thi aur chashma bhi tha panaah di
Aye mere rasoolo! Tum paakeeza ghizaayein khaao aur nek kaam karo ke main tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hoon
Aur tum sab ka deen ek deen hai aur main hi sab ka Parwardigar hoon, lihaaza bas mujh se daro
Phir yeh log aapas mein tukde tukde ho gaye, aur har giroh jo kuch bhi us ke paas hai usi par khush aur magan hai
Ab aap inhein ek muddat ke liye isi gumraahi mein chhod dein
Kya un ka khayaal yeh hai ke hum jo kuch maal aur aulaad de rahe hain
Yeh un ki nekiyon mein ujlat ki ja rahi hai? Nahin, hargiz nahin, inhein to haqeeqat ka sha'oor bhi nahin hai
Beshak jo log khauf-e-Parwardigar se larzaan rehte hain
Aur jo apne Parwardigar ki nishaaniyon par imaan rakhte hain
Aur jo kisi ko bhi apne Rab ka shareek nahin banaate hain
Aur woh log jo ba-qadr-e-imkaan raah-e-Khuda mein dete rehte hain, aur inhein yeh khauf laga rehta hai ke palat kar usi ki baargaah mein jaane waale hain
Yahi woh log hain jo nekiyon mein sabqat karne waale hain aur sab ke aage nikal jaane waale hain
Aur hum kisi nafs ko us ki wus'at se zyaada takleef nahin dete hain, aur hamaare paas woh kitaab hai jo haq ke saath bolti hai, aur un par koi zulm nahin kiya jaata hai
Balke un ke quloob is ki taraf se bilkul jahaalat mein doobe hue hain, aur un ke paas doosre qism ke aamaal hain jinhein woh anjaam de rahe hain
Yahaan tak ke jab hum ne un ke maaldaaron ko azaab ki giraft mein le liya to ab sab faryaad kar rahe hain
Ab aaj waawaila na karo, aaj hamaari taraf se koi madad nahin ki jaaegi
Jab hamaari aayatein tumhaare saamne padhi jaati thin to tum ulte paaon waapas chale ja rahe the
Akadte hue aur qissa kehte aur bakte hue
Kya un logon ne hamaari baat par ghaur nahin kiya, ya un ke paas koi cheez aa gayi hai jo un ke baap daada ke paas bhi nahin aayi thi
Ya unhon ne apne rasool ko pehchaana hi nahin hai aur isi liye inkaar kar rahe hain
Ya un ka kehna yeh hai ke rasool mein junoon paaya jaata hai, jab ke woh un ke paas haq le kar aaya hai, aur un ki aksariyat haq ko naapasand karne waali hai

Aur agar haq un ki khwaahishaat ka ittibaa' kar leta to aasmaan o zameen aur un ke maa-bain jo kuch bhi hai sab barbaad ho jaata, balke hum ne un ko unhi ka zikr ata kiya hai aur yeh apne hi zikr se e'raaz kiye hue hain
To kya aap un se apna kharch maang rahe hain? Hargiz nahin, Khuda ka diya hua khiraaj aap ke liye bahut behtar hai, aur woh behtareen rizq dene waala hai
Aur aap to inhein seedhe raaste ki daawat dene waale hain
Aur jo log aakhirat par imaan nahin laate hain woh seedhe raaste se hate hue hain
Aur agar hum un par rahm karein aur un ki takleef ko door bhi kar dein to bhi yeh apni sarkashi par ade rahenge aur gumraah hi hote jaayenge
Aur hum ne inhein azaab ke zariye pakda bhi, magar yeh na apne Parwardigar ke saamne jhuke aur na hi gidgidaate hain
Yahaan tak ke hum ne shadeed azaab ka darwaaza khol diya to usi mein maayoos ho kar baith rahe
Woh wahi Khuda hai jis ne tumhaare liye kaan aur aankhein aur dil banaaye hain, magar tum bahut kam shukriya ada karte ho
Aur usi ne tumhein saari zameen mein phaila diya hai, aur usi ki baargaah mein tum ikattha kiye jaaoge
Wahi woh hai jo hayaat o maut ka dene waala hai, aur usi ke ikhtiyaar mein din aur raat ki aamad o raft hai, to tum aql kyon nahin istemaal karte ho
Balke un logon ne bhi wahi keh diya jo un ke pehle waalon ne kaha tha
Ke agar hum mar gaye aur mitti aur haddi ho gaye to kya hum dobaara uthaaye jaane waale hain
Beshak aisa hi waada hum se bhi kiya gaya hai aur hum se pehle waalon se bhi kiya gaya hai, lekin yeh sirf puraane logon ki kahaaniyaan hain
To zara aap poochhiye ke yeh zameen aur us ki makhlooqaat kis ke liye hai agar tumhaare paas kuch bhi ilm hai
Yeh fauran kahenge ke Allah ke liye hai. To kahiye ke phir samajhte kyon nahin ho
Phir mazeed kahiye ke saaton aasmaan aur Arsh-e-A'zam ka maalik kaun hai
To yeh phir kahenge ke Allah hi hai. To kahiye ke aakhir us se darte kyon nahin ho
Phir kahiye ke har shai ki hukoomat kis ke ikhtiyaar mein hai, ke wahi panaah deta hai aur usi ke azaab se koi panaah dene waala nahin hai, agar tumhaare paas koi bhi ilm hai
To yeh fauran jawaab denge ke yeh sab Allah ke liye hai. To kahiye ke aakhir phir tum par kaun sa jaadoo kiya ja raha hai
Balke hum un ke paas haq le kar aaye hain aur yeh sab jhoote hain

Yaqeenan Khuda ne kisi ko farzand nahin banaaya hai aur na us ke saath koi doosra khuda hai, warna har khuda apni makhlooqaat ko le kar alag ho jaata aur har ek doosre par bartari ki fikr karta aur kaainaat tabaah o barbaad ho jaati. Allah un tamaam baaton se paak o paakeeza hai
Woh haazir o ghaaib sab ka jaanne waala hai, aur un sab ke shirk se buland o baala-tar hai
Aur aap kahiye ke Parwardigar! Agar jis azaab ka un se waada kiya hai mujhe dikha bhi dena
To Parwardigar! Mujhe is zaalim qaum ke saath na qaraar dena
Aur hum jis azaab ka un se waada kar rahe hain use aap ko dikha dene ki qudrat bhi rakhte hain
Aur aap buraai ko achchhaai ke zariye rafa' kijiye, ke hum un ki baaton ko khoob jaante hain
Aur kahiye ke Parwardigar! Main shaitaanon ke waswason se teri panaah chaahta hoon
Aur is baat se panaah maangta hoon ke shayaateen mere paas aa jaayein
Yahaan tak ke jab un mein se kisi ki maut aa gayi to kehne laga ke Parwardigar! Mujhe palta de
Shaayad main ab koi nek amal anjaam doon. Hargiz nahin, yeh ek baat hai jo yeh keh raha hai, aur un ke peechhe ek aalam-e-barzakh hai jo qiyaamat ke din tak qaaim rehne waala hai
Phir jab Soor phoonka jaaega to na rishtedaariyaan hongi aur na aapas mein koi ek doosre ke haalaat poochhega
Phir jin ki nekiyon ka palla bhaari hoga woh kaamyaab aur najaat paane waale honge
Aur jin ki nekiyon ka palla halka hoga woh wahi log honge jinhon ne apne nafs ko khasaare mein daal diya hai, aur woh Jahannam mein hamesha hamesha rehne waale hain
Jahannam ki aag un ke chehron ko jhulas degi aur woh usi mein munh banaaye hue honge
Kya aisa nahin hai ke jab hamaari aayatein tumhaare saamne padhi jaati thin to tum un ki takzeeb kiya karte the
Woh log kahenge ke Parwardigar! Hum par badbakhti ghaalib aa gayi thi aur hum gumraah ho gaye the
Parwardigar! Ab humein Jahannam se nikaal de, us ke baad dobaara gunaah karein to hum waaqai zaalim hain
Irshaad hoga ke ab isi mein zillat ke saath pade raho aur baat na karo
Hamaare bandon mein ek giroh aisa bhi tha jin ka kehna tha ke Parwardigar! Hum imaan laaye hain, lihaaza hamaare gunaahon ko maaf kar de aur hum par rahm farma ke tu behtareen rahm karne waala hai
To tum logon ne un ko bilkul mazaaq bana liya tha, yahaan tak ke is mazaaq ne tumhein hamaari yaad se bilkul ghaafil bana diya aur tum un ka mazhaka hi udaate reh gaye
Aaj ke din hum ne un ko yeh jaza di hai ke woh saraasar kaamyaab hain
Phir Khuda poochhega ke tum roo-e-zameen par kitne saal rahe
Woh jawaab denge ke ek din ya us ka bhi ek hi hissa, ise to shumaar karne waalon se daryaaft kar le
Irshaad hoga ke beshak tum bahut mukhtasar rahe ho, aur kaash tumhein is ka idraak hota
Kya tumhaara khayaal yeh tha ke hum ne tumhein bekaar paida kiya hai aur tum hamaari taraf palta kar nahin laaye jaaoge
Pas buland o baala hai woh Khuda jo baadshaah-e-barhaq hai, aur us ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, aur woh Arsh-e-Kareem ka Parwardigar hai
Aur jo Allah ke saath kisi aur khuda ko pukaarega jis ki koi daleel bhi nahin hai to us ka hisaab Parwardigar ke paas hai, aur kaafiron ke liye najaat bahar-haal nahin hai
Aur Paighambar! Aap kahiye ke Parwardigar! Meri maghfirat farma aur mujh par rahm kar ke tu behtareen rahm karne waala hai
